notes.intro: The same version on the Mac App Store and as a download.
New: Settings › About with the version, updates, the Guide and the third-party licenses.

Fixed: Folders like `v1.2` keep their name when a copy already exists.

notes.intro: The first version of Unfold for Mac: RAR, ZIP, 7z and more, right in Finder. Signed and notarized by Apple; it updates itself.

New: Settings > General and the welcome screen show whether Unfold is in Finder's right-click menu, with **Turn On…** to switch it on.
With many archives, the one being unfolded is on top of the list and finished ones move to the bottom.
Fixed: A password you just typed is tried first for the other archives waiting for one, so Unfold doesn't ask again.

Changed: The Finder menu now shows only in your home folder. This works around a macOS bug that puts Unfold's icon on every drive. Turn it on for all drives in Settings > General.
The small progress window closes by itself when done.
Fixed: The list is emptied when you close the window.

notes.intro: The first version for iPhone and iPad.
New: Unfold right in Files: **Share › Unfold Archive**. The app stays closed, and the files appear next to the archive.
Open archives from Files, Mail, Safari or any app with “Open in Unfold”.
Multipart RAR sets unfold as one.
Saved passwords are tried for you, and stay in your Keychain.
With many archives, the one being unfolded is on top of the list and finished ones move to the bottom.
Fixed: A password you just typed is tried first for the other archives waiting for one, so Unfold doesn't ask again.
